summary: Controls total response effort across internal reasoning, visible answer text, and tool use. Lower levels reduce latency and output-token cost; higher levels let Claude spend more tokens exploring, checking, and completing difficult work.
combines: Sent as output_config.effort and independent of max_tokens, which remains the hard output ceiling.
Adaptive thinking is provider-managed on the newest models and enabled internally on the 4.6 through 4.8 models that otherwise default it off.
Changing effort can change prompt-cache prefixes; keep it stable within a cached conversation.
note: Per-model options are synchronized: low/medium/high/xhigh/max on Fable 5, Opus 5, Opus 4.8, Opus 4.7 and Sonnet 5; low/medium/high/max on Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6; unavailable on Haiku 4.5.

usage.what: Sets the user-selected reasoning effort for a compatible model. Conversational turns persist the accepted model profile, controls, and resolved Bedrock inference-profile ID; recovery reuses them and rejects a changed registry model version. Matrix prompt preparations retain one snapshot per preparation and selected model.
usage.from: The selected model reasoning configuration or its synchronized default, validated by resolveAgentReasoningOptions; explicit unsupported or conflicting controls are rejected.
